what_happened: Scene layout 8 (log-cabin kitchen, robot right of the dishwasher), white/pink cup_5 and wooden bowl_7. Stage 0: the arm stayed near its start pose while the view shifted (base repositioning) until ~240, then approached the cup and grasped it 400-406 (first contact 399; successes touch the first dish at ~105-165). It released the cup on the slid-out rack at 544; stage 0 complete 547 (median 298, p90 336). Stage 1: bowl grasped 678-687 and lowered into the rack next to the cup; while placing it the fingers/bowl caught the cup (cup 'hold' 817-864, lifted 3 cm and tipped 855-865, it righted itself by ~900). Bowl released 865; stage 1 complete 866 (319 steps). Stage 2 (334 steps left, more than the p90 273): the gripper never left the rack. From 866 to 1200 it stayed pointing down between the bowl and the cup, touching the bowl (touch 873-1200), closed on it once at 946 without lifting, and made almost no motion. The rack was never pushed in and the door was touched only at 870/873 (closedness 0.00 at the end).
causal_chain: slow start (first contact 399) -> stage 0 at 547, stage 1 at 866 -> after the second placement the policy kept the gripper on the bowl in the rack for the remaining 334 steps (re-close 946) -> never pushed the rack in or went to the door -> fail
self_recovery: none; the cup it knocked over during the bowl placement righted itself.
official_criterion_notes: Stage 1 counts as complete 866-1200 although the gripper touches the bowl almost continuously, because the stage check latches the 'released' part after the first release (atomic_steps_seen11._order_step). The _task.json definition ('gripper not touching either') is stricter than what is measured.

packet_facts: dishwasher touch 870, 873 only; door 0.00 at end

uncertain_about: Why the policy stalls at the bowl (the bowl rests tilted ~21 deg against the rack wires; it may look unfinished to the policy).
